subject: Request: Short-term eval access while PO clears
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Short-term eval access while PO clears

Hi Rachel,

We're excited about the proof-of-concept with Redwood — the eng team is lined up to run the integration next week. Procurement has the PO in review but their internal approval queue has hit a snag (they need a legal addendum for security clauses). Our procurement lead estimated clearance will take ~10 business days.

We wanted to ask whether Redwood can provision a short-term keepalive (temporary credits or an interim account extension) so our engineers can finish the integration and run the workload validation while the PO is finalizing. Ideally were asking for two weeks of access and roughly 50k tokens of complimentary credits to complete the eval.

Attached: SOW_Draft.pdf (current draft of scope). I can also loop legal if you need a contact.

Appreciate any help here — the timeline is tight and our execs are watching the pilot.

Thanks,
Laura Simmons
Director of Product, Nimbus Health
laura.simmons@nimbushealth.com
(415) 555-0193

Thanks Laura — and congrats to your team for getting this far. Im looping Monica (Sales Ops) to confirm what we can provision quickly. A couple quick clarifying questions for our records:

- Can you confirm the PO reference number or the HubSpot deal id? (If not yet issued, just the legal contact and expected sign date is fine.)
- Are there any IP/processing/data residency clauses in the addendum that are blocking procurement specifically?
- Is 50k tokens an upper-bound estimate for the integration run, or can you share an expected daily token consumption?

If we can get a one-week interim allotment while procurement completes the addendum review, Ill route for approval and create a short-term credit package. Monica — any constraints from your side on provisional credits for enterprise pilots?

Approval: I reviewed the deal notes and the attached SOW_Draft.pdf. Given Nimbus Health is a strategic pilot (healthcare vertical, potential for Dedicated in the future) I approve a one-week provisional credit package so engineers can finish validation. Conditions:

- Provision: 25,000 free token credits applied to their evaluation account immediately.
- Expiry: credits expire 2026-08-10T23:59:00-07:00 (one week from provisioning).
- Contingency: If PO is not received by expiry, we will reach back out 48 hours prior to expiry to consider a second one-week extension; any further extension requires AE + Manager sign-off.
- Required info: HubSpot deal id or PO number (send to ops@redwood.com for tracking).

Attachment: approval_form.pdf (internal approval stub).

Monica Patel
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
